spec.description: The Terminal Aerodrome Forecasts issued for an airport station over roughly the last week, newest first. Only when and for how long each one applies: the forecast text is at each one's `id`, which answers only in XML.

station_id.description: Station identifier of an airport, such as `KSEA`. `stations.list_stations` returns it as `stationIdentifier`.

response.title: TafCollection
response.description: The forecasts, as a JSON-LD graph.

items.title: TafSummary
items.description: When one Terminal Aerodrome Forecast was issued, and the span it covers.

id.description: URL of the forecast itself, such as `https://api.weather.gov/stations/KSEA/tafs/2026-09-30/1700`. It answers only in IWXXM XML, which is why no endpoint here fetches it.

location.description: Station identifier of the airport, such as `KSEA`.

start.description: Start of the span the forecast covers.

end.description: End of the span the forecast covers.

geometry.description: Where the airport is, as Well-Known Text: `POINT(47.44 -122.31)`. Latitude first, the reverse of the GeoJSON `coordinates` elsewhere in this API.

notes: JSON-LD, not GeoJSON: the service answers `application/ld+json` whatever `Accept` asks for, as the OpenAPI documents.
